target.statement: RFOD's AUC-ROC on the Wine dataset (a single cell of the per-dataset accuracy results in Figure 5), demonstrating the main detection-accuracy contribution on the smallest benchmark dataset.

compute.basis: No code is released, so the full RFOD pipeline (per-feature RFs, OOB pruning, AGD, UWA) plus the unsupervised train/test split protocol must be reimplemented from the paper; the Wine dataset is tiny so actual compute is minutes, but matching the paper's exact split/preprocessing to hit the reported number is the real cost.

blockers: No code or configs released (empty link list)
Exact train/test split and anomaly-label protocol for Wine not fully specified, so the exact reported AUC-ROC cell may not be reproducible
Baseline comparison context (10 methods) would require reimplementing/installing many baselines if the full figure is targeted
title: RFOD: Random Forest-based Outlier Detection for Tabular Data
